title: August and the Summer
author: Kestrel Dunmore
blurb: Vesper Almeida, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
